audit.why: 56.22% over 1407 games, the best matchup in this slice, and the shape is right — she owns the early levels on Harrier-fed kiting and loses everything from the moment Malphite has armour and an ultimate, because nothing in her kit is percent-health or true damage.

audit.whatIsWrong: content.win reads Quinn, Skill, Malphite, Malphite, Quinn, Malphite, Malphite — it gives Quinn Level 6 while content.mid says 'At 6, Unstoppable Force is everything' and spikes[1].text calls level 6 the stage that flips the lane.

Handing her the 6 contradicts the one stage the page builds toward. Enum cells cannot pass the length band so it is recorded here.

audit.whatIsWrong: content.early says 'her E vault knocks you back AND blinds your next autos', spikes[0].text calls it 'E vault-blind', and whys[0] says 'Harrier passive and E blind'. Three strings put the blind on the wrong ability.
audit.why: The blind is Blinding Assault (Q), 11/10.5/10/9.5/9 at 1025 range. Vault (E) is 12/11/10/9/8 at 675 and it dashes, slows, briefly interrupts and repositions her — no blind. The confusion costs the player a real read: the blind and the escape are two separate buttons on two separate cooldowns, so baiting the dash does nothing about the blind and vice versa. The corrected version lets them be tracked independently.
audit.corrected: Blinding Assault (Q) is the blind, 11/10.5/10/9.5/9 at 1025. Vault (E) is the reposition, 12/11/10/9/8.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page says the blind makes 'even your W empowered hits whiff' but never says what still works.
audit.why: Blind stops basic attacks. Thunderclap's aftershocks are created by his attacks, so a blind does turn W off. Ground Slam is a spell — Riot's text is 'Malphite slams the ground, sending out a shockwave' — so it is unaffected and still applies the attack-speed reduction. That gives the blinded Malphite something to actually press instead of walking away, which is the difference between conceding the trade and taking it.
audit.corrected: Blinded, your Thunderclap autos do nothing but Ground Slam still lands — cast E rather than trying to auto through it.

audit.whatIsWrong: The _missing-interactions file records two entries for this pairing claiming Malphite can deny Vault with Seismic Shard and Ground Slam via grounding.
audit.why: Malphite's kit file does flag grounding on Q and E, but Riot's descriptions do not support it: Seismic Shard 'deals damage upon impact and steals Move Speed', Ground Slam 'deals magic damage based on his Armor and reduces the Attack Speed'. Neither mentions grounding or dash denial, and the calibration rule says the description wins. So no dash-denial claim was written, and the existing correct line — that Q only slows and she vaults out of it — was left standing.
sources: champ-data/_kits/malphite.json Q and E descriptions vs flags

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns gave Vault no number, then two placeholder lines.
audit.why: Vault 12/11/10/9/8 is the engage window and the page's whole mid-game plan depends on counting it. Blinding Assault 11/10.5/10/9.5/9 runs on almost the same clock, which is why the two get confused; and Heightened Senses at 50/45/40/35/30 is a long reveal that matters for whether a fog flank is even possible.

audit.whatIsWrong: Heightened Senses is never mentioned in either layer, though content.late tells the player not to facecheck for her.
audit.why: Heightened Senses is an active reveal over a large area on a 50s cooldown at rank 1, and it is flagged revealsStealth. It is the reason a fog flank can simply fail. The advice 'don't facecheck for her' is right but the page never says she can look first.
audit.corrected: Heightened Senses reveals a large area on 50/45/40/35/30 — she can check your fog flank before you take it.

edits.before: Quinn owns these levels outright. Her Harrier passive gives her free nimble move speed to weave in autos and walk out, and her E vault knocks you back AND blinds your next autos — so even your W empowered hits whiff. You have no trade pattern at all here: Q-Seismic Shard only slows, and she vaults out of it. Don't walk up to throw a Q she can vault and punish. Soak XP, let Granite Shield refresh between her pokes, and just survive to 6.
edits.after: Quinn owns these levels outright. Harrier marks you and Heightened Senses feeds her move and attack speed once she hits a marked target, so she weaves autos and walks out. The blind is Blinding Assault (Q, 11s at rank 1), not her dash — and a blind makes Thunderclap's empowered autos whiff while Ground Slam, a spell, still lands. Vault (E, 12s at rank 1) is how she resets distance. Soak XP, refresh Granite Shield, survive to 6.

edits.before: This is where you take the lane back. Q-slow her the instant her E vault is down — that's the only window she can't reset distance — and your armor coming online from W lets you farm through the poke. At 6, Unstoppable Force is everything: it's unstoppable, so her vault knockback and Harrier kiting can't peel it. Don't blow R on a fullHP Quinn at range; bait her E, eat the blind, then R the second she vaults so she has no second escape. Watch the minimap — she'll try to roam, and your R-flank punishes that harder than she can punish you.
edits.after: This is where you take the lane back. Q-slow her the instant Vault is down — 12s at rank 1 is the only window she cannot reset distance in — and Thunderclap's armour lets you farm through the poke. At 6 Unstoppable Force is everything. Don't blow it on a full-HP Quinn at range: bait Vault, and if Blinding Assault is on you cast Ground Slam rather than autoing, because the blind eats attacks and never spells. Then R the second she vaults so she has no second escape. Watch the minimap — your R-flank punishes her roams harder than she punishes yours.

notes: Main correction: the blind belongs to Blinding Assault (Q, 11s at rank 1), not to Vault. Three strings had them fused, which hides the fact that her escape and her blind are separate buttons on separate cooldowns. The best new line is what survives the blind — a blind stops basic attacks, so Thunderclap's aftershocks stop with them, but Ground Slam is a spell and still lands with its attack-speed cut. Two claims in _missing-interactions for this pairing say Malphite grounds her Vault with Q and E; Riot's descriptions of both abilities mention no grounding at all, so nothing of the kind was written and the page's existing, correct 'your Q only slows and she vaults out of it' was left alone.
